target.title: fix(heartbeat): inject Slack interaction value into heartbeat prompt\…
target.body:
Fixes #99544

## What Problem This Solves

Fixes #99544 (follow-up to #61502). Slack interactive button clicks wake the target session and thread, but the clicked action's `value` / `action_id` never reaches the agent as input. `consumeSelectedSystemEventEntries` removes the interaction entry from the system event queue, yet the event text was never injected into the heartbeat prompt.

## Why This Change Was Made

The heartbeat runner's prompt resolution has dedicated builders for exec-completion and cron events, but the generic fallback path never includes system event text. When a Slack hook wake triggers a heartbeat with no exec/cron events, the generic heartbeat prompt is used and the interaction payload is silently dropped.

This change adds a Slack-interaction-typed branch:

- `src/infra/heartbeat-events-filter.ts`: add `isSlackInteractionEvent()` and `buildSlackInteractionEventPrompt()`
- `src/infra/heartbeat-runner.ts`: route pending system events whose `contextKey` starts with `slack:interaction:` to the new builder, mirroring the exec/cron branches

Unlike a generic "prepend all system event text" approach, this only touches events explicitly queued as Slack interactions, so it does not widen the prompt-injection surface for arbitrary system events.

The prompt builder renders **all** queued Slack interactions (with a cap of 5 rendered entries plus an overflow summary), preserving symmetry with `selectSystemEventsConsumedByHeartbeat` so no interaction is consumed without being rendered.

## User Impact

Users clicking Slack interactive buttons will see the `action_id` and `value` reflected in the agent's heartbeat turn, including multiple rapid clicks coalesced into a single wake. No other heartbeat behavior changes.

## Evidence

Unit tests:

```bash
$ node scripts/run-vitest.mjs run src/infra/heartbeat-events-filter.test.ts

 ✓ |unit-fast| src/infra/heartbeat-events-filter.test.ts (53 tests) 16ms

 Test Files  1 passed (1)
      Tests  53 passed (53)
```

Integration tests (covers the multi-interaction render/consume symmetry raised by reviewer):

```bash
$ node scripts/run-vitest.mjs run src/infra/heartbeat-runner.slack-interaction.test.ts

 ✓ |infra| src/infra/heartbeat-runner.slack-interaction.test.ts (4 tests) 42ms

 Test Files  1 passed (1)
      Tests  4 passed (4)
```

Regression check on existing heartbeat runner tests:

```bash
$ node scripts/run-vitest.mjs run src/infra/heartbeat-runner.returns-default-unset.test.ts

 ✓ |infra| src/infra/heartbeat-runner.returns-default-unset.test.ts (43 tests) 552ms

 Test Files  1 passed (1)
      Tests  43 passed (43)
```

Format / lint:

```bash
$ npx oxfmt --check src/infra/heartbeat-events-filter.ts \
  src/infra/heartbeat-events-filter.test.ts \
  src/infra/heartbeat-runner.ts \
  src/infra/heartbeat-runner.slack-interaction.test.ts
All matched files use the correct format.

$ npx oxlint@latest src/infra/heartbeat-events-filter.ts \
  src/infra/heartbeat-events-filter.test.ts \
  src/infra/heartbeat-runner.ts \
  src/infra/heartbeat-runner.slack-interaction.test.ts
Found 0 warnings and 0 errors.

$ git diff --check
# no output
```

Key assertions from the integration test show the prompt body contains both interactions when two are queued:

```
Slack interactive button(s) were clicked:
1. action_id="approve_pr" with value="merge-99544"
2. action_id="reject_pr" with value="close-99544"

Please act on these interaction(s). Reply HEARTBEAT_OK.
```
